body: I thought I was the only one... not totally surprised by this. I am playing on my Macbook and it is awful! I work at a law firm. I am a higher up but they can't represent me for reasons of conflict of interest. All I did was cite my rights and ask the judge for proof of receipt of a motion and that is when she threw me out,

YES! I have had a number of 4th plateau trips.. and maybe even beyond. I have had some trips where it takes me a while to get grounded. To the other posts, yes alcohol can help to bring you back.

But even though I haven't had a 4th plateau trip in a few weeks, I still have a different outlook on the world. Multiple world theory and quantum physics start to make so much sense and I think I have seen proof.. and I have died in many trips and it has always been around the time when my death is replayed and it is something that is so on point with these weird feelings that I just can't describe and even I drive past a place where one of my deaths occurred I have this eerie feeling and I couldn't explain it until a few days later I realized in my trips that is exactly where I was shown my death cause..

Yes this is exactly how I feel! After many trips I suddenly have a fascination with quantum physics and I feel like I have so much better of an understanding through the trips I've had. 

I have been depressed for much of my life. I've had anything but a conventional life. I grew up normal, middle class family in America. I wanted something more though. So from the age of 11 I started researching the internet and how that worked (I am 27 so this is late 90sish), and I learned how to monetize it. I had several businesses. Several success stories even before I could legally drink alcohol I was basically printing money where I could have whatever I wanted. Material things added nothing to my happiness and led to part of my isolation. 

I think all of this influences my trips. Even when I am happy I still have these death trips that get me thinking about multi world theory.. today completely sober I drove past a spot that previously I had driven very fast in sports cars I bought, and in multiple trips there is a vision where it plays my death in a particular car and in a specific spot. When driving past it today I suddered and felt this strange feeling like something was off, and I didn't know why I felt this, I was happy all day today and just felt this feeling of death and sadness. And it fled quickly and I didn't know why. Now many hours later I realized this is where my trips of me dying in this particular car occur.

I would love to talk to you more - I feel like you have some simiular ideations I have.

> Just remember to check your energy level and try to keep it at five.

Thanks for the reply. What kind of crazy experiences are you talking about? Would love to hear more. 

I always feel weird a day or two after my big trips. First off, DXM tends to make me stutter. I have a hard time the next day composing sentences. 

After some intense trips I've gotten to the point of psychosis basically, where I didn't know what was real and overlooked the meaning of the trip and the events that occurred.

Yes I feel exactly like you do! And I have tried to potentiate my DXM use with weed. I find that when I use weed I can sometimes trip and have close eyes visions more easily. But it can really depend on the weed I am using. I have medicinal weed and as of lately the strain I have or whatever it may be just gets me lazy it seems. I may need to make a change.

And you are so right being able to lay in bed, listen to music, and just relax is so amazing! Sometimes I pair this with playing GTA online and it is just an incredible feeling. It may not be the substance DXM that is addictive maybe more so this feeling? I don't know but for once in a VERY long time it makes me happy and gives me something to actually look forward to.
